Soldier.glb (embedded as base64 in soldier-glb.js)

Rigged, animated human soldier model taken from the three.js examples
(github.com/mrdoob/three.js, examples/models/gltf/Soldier.glb, MIT-licensed
repository). The character is "Vanguard by T. Choonyung" from Adobe Mixamo
(mixamo.com), which permits royalty-free use of characters and animations in
projects. Includes Idle / Walk / Run / TPose motion-capture clips.
